_comment: Single source of truth for X8_LEVEL (RC-2b). Read by scripts/lib/x8-production-like-env.sh (bash, via `node -e`) and scripts/acceptance/x8-validate-compose.mjs (Node) so both sides assert the exact same values. Each level's workerTaskAllowlist/flags must stay letter-for-letter identical to the matching section in docs/p2/V020_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md ('## 3. Flag 分级开放' -> Level 0 / Level UAT / Level R). promoClaimRoles is NOT one of the checklist's eight double-gate flags: it is the PROMO_CLAIM_ROLES admin-capability grant (src/lib/auth/capabilities.ts), which the double-gates alone cannot supply -- without it the /catalog-sync claim dialog's apply mode stays blocked no matter what FEATURE_PROMO_LINK_CLAIM says. Level 0 keeps it empty (granted to nobody), matching the capability's own defaultRoles: []. catalogSyncDefaultGateState only seeds scripts/lib/x8-production-like-env.sh's catalog-gate state file on its very first run for a given level; the existing `gate catalog-write on|off|dry-run` command still overrides it afterward, unchanged. adminTwoFactorEnforcement (RC-10) is the ADMIN_TWO_FACTOR_ENFORCEMENT value for the web service (src/lib/auth/two-factor-enforcement.ts): canonical values are 'true' (enforced) / 'false' (disabled) -- 'required'/'disabled' remain accepted synonyms, see that file. 'true' everywhere except Level UAT, which is 'false' by Owner decision (2026-09-04) -- local UAT only, never Level 0 (pre-deploy) or Level R (production). adminLocalIdentitySeed (RC-11) is the ADMIN_LOCAL_IDENTITY_SEED value consumed by scripts/ensure-local-admin-identities.ts (fail-closed: only the exact value 'allow' lets that script seed the local admin/admin2 fixture accounts, and it also relaxes hashAdminPassword's 12-character floor for those two accounts only). 'allow' only at Level UAT; Level 0 and Level R leave it '' (unset in practice -- exported empty by x8_level_config() is equivalent to unset for that script's exact-match check), matching adminTwoFactorEnforcement's UAT-only carve-out. PR6 lane F added the P2-06.5 tagging double-gate (plus auto-classify's own pair) to `flags`: FEATURE_P2_06_5_TAGGING (master read gate; src/server/tagging/admin-service.ts's requireTaggingRead) and FEATURE_P2_06_5_TAG_ADMIN_WRITE (Admin V1 UI write gate) are 'true' at Level UAT and Level R (production reads + hand-authored writes are both in scope past Level 0) and 'false' at Level 0. FEATURE_NOVEL_TAG_AUTO and AUTO_WRITE_AUTHORIZED gate the separate auto-classification task chain and stay 'false'/'NO' at every level -- AUTO_WRITE_AUTHORIZED is a fail-closed exact-match string ('YES' required, not a boolean) and this table must never set it to anything but 'NO' until Owner explicitly authorizes auto-write (P2-06.5 ADR); scripts/acceptance/x8-validate-compose.mjs asserts this invariant independently of what value is written here. C-25 (规划_文章管理能力补齐_博客类型可见性换小说_2026-09-08.md §三/C-25) added FEATURE_ARTICLE_SEO_VISIBILITY to `flags`: a single gate (no ALLOW_WRITE partner -- it only gates public-site reads, see docs/governance/feature-flag-registry.md's own note on why), read by BOTH the web and worker services -- worker/handlers/sitemap-refresh.ts's createSitemapFamilyBuilder and worker/handlers/indexnow-delivery.ts's isNovelIndexNowEligible->isHiddenFromPublicView both default their env param to process.env, i.e. the worker process's own copy of this var, so it must be registered in worker's docker-compose.yml passthrough too (a P0 review fix: it was previously web-only there, silently pinning the worker's read to 'false'); only scheduler is exempt (enqueue-only, no public-site read path to gate) and correctly stays absent from x8-validate-compose.mjs's scheduler-loop assertions -- but that script's worker array must now include this key alongside its web array's copy, not omit it. 'false' at Level 0 and Level R (production stays off pending a separate Owner-approved open-the-gate step, same 'register false, flip later' discipline as every other flag that starts closed) and 'true' at Level UAT (so Owner's own local UAT can exercise the public-facing seo_only/hidden behavior, not just the always-on admin controls). C-28 (规划_文章管理能力补齐_博客类型可见性换小说_2026-09-08.md §三/C-28) added FEATURE_ARTICLE_BLOG/ARTICLE_BLOG_ALLOW_WRITE to `flags`: a genuine double-gate (protected write, unlike FEATURE_ARTICLE_SEO_VISIBILITY above). FEATURE_ARTICLE_BLOG itself is read by BOTH the web and worker services, not web-only -- src/lib/seo/sitemap.ts's createSitemapFamilyBuilder (worker) reads isArticleBlogEnabled(env) (env defaults to process.env, i.e. the worker's own copy) to gate the blogpage sitemap family (added by C-29, 规划_文章管理能力补齐_博客类型可见性换小说_2026-09-08.md §三/C-29), so x8-validate-compose.mjs's worker loop also asserts FEATURE_ARTICLE_BLOG (not paired with ARTICLE_BLOG_ALLOW_WRITE there -- the worker never performs the blog write). ARTICLE_BLOG_ALLOW_WRITE itself remains web-only (no worker/scheduler caller). 'false'/'false' at every level (0/uat/r) -- this capability has no Owner-approved open-the-gate step yet, same 'register false, flip later' discipline as every other flag that starts closed. C-30A (施工工单_C30_换小说_移植CPS换租客_2026-09-08.md §4A.5/附录 E) added FEATURE_ARTICLE_NOVEL_REBIND/ARTICLE_NOVEL_REBIND_ALLOW_WRITE to `flags`: a genuine double-gate (protected two-field Article.novelId+promoLinkId atomic write), web-only (the rebind capability -- single-article service, editor-page panel, and C-30B's batch preview/apply/page -- is entirely Server-Action-driven; grepped for a worker/scheduler consumer before registering, none exists). 'false'/'false' at every level (0/uat/r) -- this capability has no Owner-approved open-the-gate step yet, same 'register false, flip later' discipline as every other flag that starts closed.
